scope: G1-05/G1-06 design HOLD, never manufacturing approval
source: Existing G1-95 TPS259474LRPW review: nominal R_ILM 2.21k and typical ILIM = 3334/R_ohms. This is a REVIEW assumption, not verified min/max; separate 3.3V TPS62933 draws from shared 5V_RAW.

assumptions.notes: Two concurrent phases is a conservative provisional profile; actual driver current and dynamic waveform unknown

physical_tests_required: Read and verify actual motor SKU, phase winding resistance and rated maximum phase current
Measure driver per-axis simultaneous phase excitation and stalled/energization current
Verify TPS259474 eFuse guaranteed current-limit min/max and all temperature/ILIM resistor tolerance
Measure 3V3 buck peak consumption and conversion efficiency at representative screen/control load
Verify 5V_RAW supply/cable/connector rating covers simultaneous motor and 3V3 demand with margins
Execute instrumented eFuse startup/stall/STOP/PG-loss/brownout HIL with current and temperature logs
